let k' := k
have h_k_nonzero : k' ≠ 0 := hk0
have h_gcd_1 : gcd 1 k' = 1 := by simp
have h_exists_prime : ∃ p, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ≡ 1 [MOD k'] :=
  Nat.Prime.exists_prime_in_arithmetic_progression 1 k' h_gcd_1
let ⟨p, hp, hp_mod⟩ := h_exists_prime
have h_p_gt_n : n < p :=
  let ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.Prime.exists_prime_greater_than n hp
  hm
exact ⟨p, hp, h_p_gt_n, hp_mod⟩
